scope: Read-only cached ASR metadata, bounded lexical aggregate inspection, source review and original deterministic text controls. No downloaded source sentences, translations, titles or audio copied. No model/GPU calls or queue mutations.

asr.caveat: Language is auto-detected for the first chunk and then pinned, so these are not independent language detections.

sample_method: Simple fixed English function-word and romanized-Hindi marker sets applied locally to first/middle/last200 ASR words. This is a script/lexical check, not independent ASR or semantic language detection.

translation_cache_snapshot.caveat: Cache was active; this is one non-atomic snapshot. Script and labels do not prove semantic correctness.

conclusion_for_current_job: Available cache evidence is consistent with English transcript text. It does not demonstrate that the downloaded audio is Hindi/mixed, nor rule out first-chunk language misclassification or a selected translated audio track. No audio was listened to.

general_non_english_support_findings.issue: Source-language context is not carried into translation/review
general_non_english_support_findings.evidence: ASR source text enters LineSpec.en unchanged; scene, brief and review instructions explicitly call it English.

general_non_english_support_findings.impact: Non-English source can request inappropriate length variants and cannot train the English-syllable prior normally.

general_non_english_support_findings.issue: English-specific deterministic coverage checks are unsound for Hindi
general_non_english_support_findings.impact: A true translated negation can receive a false mismatch, while a removed Hindi negation or changed spelled-out Hindi number can escape the corrective validator.

general_non_english_support_findings.issue: User-facing scope is broader than tested implementation
general_non_english_support_findings.evidence: UI says any YouTube video, while documented contract and deterministic source-language rules assume English.

recommendation: Treat multilingual inputs as a separate quality-support task: carry source language into prompts, make the length prior language-aware and gate English-only heuristic corrections or replace them with validated language-aware checks. Preserve current queue unchanged; do not attribute current xi correction rate to Hindi based on available evidence.
limits: No independent audio-language or transcription verification.
No native listening or model quality evaluation.
Original local controls demonstrate implementation limitations, not downloaded-video errors.
